Recommended rollback design: wrap each probe in `try/finally` or `ExitStack`, registering cleanup immediately after each mutation. Remove only hooks installed by that probe using `handle.remove()`; `always_call=True` does not replace cleanup. `state_dict()` contains tensor references, so deep-copy it or clone tensor values before mutation; separately snapshot nonpersistent buffers and mutable attributes. Restore tensor contents under `torch.no_grad()` without replacing Parameter objects. Save every module’s `.training` flag and restore individually, preserving mixed train/eval modes. Also restore changed gradients and `requires_grad` flags. These recommendations follow [PyTorch Module semantics](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.Module.html).

Preserve Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA RNG states and every explicit generator touched. [`torch.random.fork_rng`](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/random.html) restores Torch RNG state, but Python/NumPy and explicit generators need separate handling. Save DataLoader/sampler generator states before constructing diagnostic iterators. Restoring generator state does not rewind consumed batches, worker RNG, or prefetch queues; use a separate diagnostic loader with its own generator, preferably `num_workers=0`, or cached cloned batches. [PyTorch reproducibility guidance](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/docs/source/notes/randomness.md) explains loader seeding.

For optional dependencies, import inside the dependent probe. Test absence using scoped `patch.dict(sys.modules, {'optional_package': None})`, or a targeted import mock raising `ModuleNotFoundError`; patch cached references where used. [Python mock documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/library/unittest.mock-examples.html) covers scoped patches and exception injection. Keep completed metrics and definitions in an outer accumulator; catch failures per probe, record unavailable/error status separately, and continue after successful rollback. Assert completed metrics survive, subsequent probes run, and model/RNG state matches snapshots. A rollback failure should stop further probes rather than permit contaminated results.
